messages:
Taylor Brooks: hi team, taylor here (day 2). opened a tiny PR but Buildkite checkout errored with a 403 — not sure who to ping for CI access.
Buildkite Bot: Build #329 (taylor/fix-typo) failed · exit code 128 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/329
Taylor Brooks: checkout snippet: 
```
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/api.git/'
```
Priya Patel: welcome! :wave: checklist: 1) add SSH key to GitHub, 2) confirm org invite accepted, 3) join eng-ci team. Which pipeline did you see?
Taylor Brooks: pipeline is "api/build-and-test". I added my SSH key but apparently new hires after the deploy-token rotation need to be in eng-ci.
Samir Rao: putting this on my radar. Buildkite pipelines sometimes use an org deploy token for HTTPS checkout so personal SSH keys won't help. I'll add you to the github org team and the pipeline team now.
Infra Oncall: FYI — deploy token rotated 2024-07-31; folks added after that need explicit membership.
Taylor Brooks: thanks, re-ran and the 403 is gone but now pip install failed with a corrupted wheel during install.
Priya Patel: we saw that after the base image bump. Try re-running with SKIP_PIP_CACHE=1 or use the Buildkite "Clear caches" option on manual run.
Samir Rao: I added you to eng-ci and pipeline teams and cleared the build cache for you. Kicked a retry.
Taylor Brooks: next run progressed but a test timed out trying to start Postgres: 
```
E TimeoutError: Postgres did not start after 60s
```
Priya Patel: if it's the docker pull being slow, set CI_DOCKER_PULL=1 or TAG=ci-latest to force fresh images. We also temporarily bumped that pipeline timeout to 300s while infra fixes registry perf.
Infra Oncall: opened INC-2024-211 for registry slow pulls causing intermittent CI timeouts.
Samir Rao: bumped job timeout and added DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES=3 for the job. Re-ran and it passed. Build link: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/331
Buildkite Bot: Build #331 (taylor/fix-typo) passed · duration 10m · https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/331
Taylor Brooks: green! thanks all, huge relief. quick Q: for GitHub Actions in other repos, do I need any extra perms to edit workflow files?
Priya Patel: you'll need write access to the repo to push workflow changes. Some repos have protected branches or restricted Actions — if so you may need an approver or an admin to enable the GitHub App on that repo.
Samir Rao: if you plan to touch infra/ci-templates, open a draft PR and ping eng-infra for a quick review. Also add [ci skip-heavy] to docs-only PR titles to avoid running heavy integration suites.
Taylor Brooks: perfect, i'll follow the onboarding checklist and mark "CI access" done. thanks everyone for the quick help!
